title: Show password prompt immediately if lock screen is displayed after a wake-from-sleep
line: After waking from sleep, the lock screen now shows the password field right away instead of just the clock.
explanation: The lock screen starts in the clock-only view and only reveals the password prompt on input, or when the authenticator sends a message. After a resume that only happened if PAM (e.g. fingerprint) answered before the screen came back, so with a password it never did. The lock screen UI now listens to the resumingFromSuspend signal it already gets from SessionManagement and shows the prompt; the usual 10 s fadeout still returns it to the clock view.

commits.message:
lockscreen: show the password prompt after waking from sleep

After resuming, the lock screen only showed the clock, and the prompt
appeared only on input or when PAM happened to send a message in time.
Now it is shown on resume and fades out after the usual timeout.

BUG: 404063

media.caption: Right after resuming (simulated logind PrepareForSleep false): only the clock is shown
Right after resuming: the password prompt is already shown
About 15 s later, with no input: back to the clock view, as before
